lane_status: self-assigned and frozen in preregistration before experiments; the prompt's single method paragraph was not identifiable (IR-S20-01)
hypothesis: Adding 1 m-DEM lidar scarp morphology and GeoDAWN radiometric composition to the 19-band habitat GBM recovers withheld whole fault components better than the identical GBM without them, because expert-labelled new faults are enriched for sub-100 m surface scarps and altered traces diluted in the 100 m bands.
mechanism: HistGradientBoosting habitat belief on 66 features (40 habitat derivatives + 15 lidar-scarp incl. sqrt(lapneg*lappos) dipole and step*coherence + 11 radiometric), no catalogue-distance inputs, halo-excluded negatives, prevalence correction, EDGE expected-marginal-DTI emission, support >2 px off-catalogue, 60000 dots. Oriented line-coherence arm tested and rejected (hurt on both seeds).
non_fault_mimic: Fluvial terrace risers and Lake Lahontan paleo-shoreline scarps (identical topographic dipoles); lithologic contacts (identical radiometric ratio steps)
